_readme: Inputs for the Entity Confidence self-check. The number on the page is COUNTED from the statuses below by seo/build-entity-score.py. Never type the total by hand. 'label' and 'status' are public (rendered on the page). 'evidence' and 'source' stay in this file.
standard: AI-Search NAP / Entity Confidence Standard v1.0
basis: Read from documents, not checked live: Business Identity Standard + Platform Punchlist (10/27, corrected 10/28), Citation Tracker (rows dated through 10/21), Master Hub (10/28), FACE live site audit (10/21), crawl-file check (10/27), Ninja-360 site repo (main, 10/29). Re-verify each status in the live profile before publishing.

top_conflict.public: The public name still shows with a hyphen (Ninja-360) in places: the website footers and schema, and the Google Business Profile rename is still in review.
top_conflict.evidence: Until this change is pasted into GoHighLevel, the footers and schema are assumed to read '© Ninja-360 Digital Media' and 'Kansas City, MO' (that is what the repo source said on 10/29; the live site was not checked). The source is fixed in this PR. GBP rename submitted 10/19, still listed as open in the 10/28 hub.

items.label: Write the one canonical NAP string
items.evidence: Identity Standard locked 10/27 and corrected 10/28; Citation Tracker NAP block corrected 10/21; llms.txt carries it (PR #11, 10/29). Hub Rule 25 still says 'Terrace'; Tim ruled 'Ter' on 10/29.
items.source: Business Identity Standard; Citation Tracker; repo llms.txt

items.label: Audit listings for duplicates and NAP conflicts
items.evidence: Punchlist names the known mismatches. Google duplicate check and the Whitespark audit are not started. The 10/19 wrap says the known-mismatch list is a starting point, not a full inventory.

items.label: Fix, merge or suppress duplicate and conflicting listings
items.evidence: Facebook has two pages (merge is irreversible, deferred). YouTube has two channels (consolidation pending). Apple stray listing unclaimed. Tracker D2 (Google duplicate check) not started.

items.label: Claim and align Google Business Profile
items.evidence: Name and category edits submitted 10/19, in Google review (tracker, 10/21). The 10/28 hub still lists the name hyphen fix as open, so the live name may still carry the hyphen. Address hidden by design (service-area business).

items.label: Claim and align Apple Business Connect
items.evidence: Stray 'Ninja 360 / Web Designer' listing shows the street address. Claim blocked on two-method verification (DNS TXT added 10/22, unconfirmed).

items.label: Claim and align Bing Places
items.evidence: Tracker: 'DONE, imported from Google 10/21'. The name on the import was not independently checked, and an import carries whatever Google showed that day.

items.label: Claim and align Yelp
items.evidence: One claimed listing (the three-record note was stale). NAP touch-up to the canonical string is still on the hands list.
items.source: 10/23 wrap; Citation Tracker D1; Master Hub 10/28

items.label: Claim and align Facebook
items.evidence: Website field points to the retired domain and the phone field is malformed (10/27 punchlist). Two pages exist. Tracker row 8: NOT STARTED.

items.label: Complete GBP basics: categories, hours, service area, contact
items.evidence: Categories submitted 10/19. Service areas (Northland) wait for the name review to clear. Hours are in the tracker NAP block but no confirmation they are live.

items.label: LocalBusiness schema on the site
items.evidence: Homepage carries ProfessionalService JSON-LD (FACE live audit 10/21) with the hyphenated name. No street address, geo or hours in the schema. Repo source matches.

items.label: Organization schema with a full sameAs array
items.evidence: sameAs lists five social profiles. GBP, Apple, Bing, Yelp and BBB are not in it. The Facebook URL differs from the page the tracker names.
items.source: FACE wrap 10/21; seo/schema/localbusiness.json; Citation Tracker row 8

items.label: Validate the schema and the sameAs links
items.evidence: No validation recorded. FACE flagged aggregateRating reviewCount=10 against 4 reviews shown on the page (10/21).

items.label: One clean aggregator push
items.evidence: Foursquare, Data Axle and TransUnion are all NOT STARTED in the tracker.

items.label: Duplicate-suppression sweep
items.evidence: No sweep recorded; depends on W3.

items.label: Start corroboration: consistent authoritative mentions
items.evidence: LinkedIn company page exists with a retired-domain website field. D&B profile update submitted 10/23 (case open). BBB not started.
items.source: Identity Standard; 10/23 wrap; Citation Tracker row 15

items.label: Create or claim a Wikidata entry
items.evidence: No entry recorded. The 9/28 wrap treats it as almost certainly not done; nothing newer.

items.label: Wire the Wikidata Q-ID into sameAs
items.evidence: Depends on K1.

items.label: Model the service-area entity cleanly
items.evidence: No record.

items.label: Quarterly entity re-audit and monitoring
items.evidence: No schedule recorded for Ninja 360 itself.

items.label: Advanced corroboration: PR and authoritative mentions
items.evidence: No record.

items.label: FAQ and Speakable schema
items.evidence: FACE recommended FAQPage schema (10/21); not present.
